title: WOW: Add two factor fields and change misidentified realm fields
description:
Continues work on https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/issues/11398.

This PR adds the two factor authentication fields that are present when two factor is enabled.

It also changes the names of two realm fields that were misidentified.

Main reference is the wiki:
https://wowdev.wiki/Packets/Login/Vanilla#Challenge_packets
and 
https://wowdev.wiki/Packets/Login/Vanilla#Server_2

Secondary is Ember:
https://github.com/EmberEmu/Ember/tree/development/src/login/grunt

Thanks to https://github.com/Chaosvex for providing the capture: [wow-auth-two-factor.pcapng](/uploads/ac66238f280275af010e4aee48850455/wow-auth-two-factor.pcapng)

I will also add this capture to the issue.
